title: Cho Aniki: Bakuretsu Ranto Hen - Flowers
description:
BG ripped from the Super Famicom game.
The hardest part was converting the layer 2 BG to layer 3. This took a lot of effort, but I did it.

Use it with a status bar patch like the DKCR status bar, Kevin's UberASM retry (sprite status bar option) , Remove status bar or any other patches / uberasm that remove / hide the layer 3 status bar.

Enjoy using it!
